columns.name: customerid
columns.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

columns.name: segment
columns.description: The segment the customer belongs to.

columns.name: consumption_in_2012
columns.description: The total amount the customer consumed in 2012, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: consumption_decrease_rate_from_2012_to_2013
columns.description: The rate of decrease in consumption from 2012 to 2013, expressed as a fraction.

columns.name: avg_price_per_single_item
columns.description: The average price per single item the customer pays.

columns.name: amount_spent_at_gas_station
columns.description: The total amount the customer spent at gas stations, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: paid_in_euro_and_avg_monthly_consumption_over_1000
columns.description: Set to 1 if the customer paid in euro and has a monthly consumption of over 1000, otherwise, set to 0
